```artifact
Feature: Patient History and Performance Requirements

  Scenario: Retrieve patient history of consultations done in the last 3 years
    Given a patient with consultation records
    When the system retrieves the patient's consultation history
    Then the system should return consultations from the last 3 years

  Scenario Outline: System performance under peak load
    Given the system is under peak load with <users> concurrent users
    When a user performs an action
    Then the system should handle the request within <response_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | users    | response_time |
      | 10000    | as specified  |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Registration Performance
    Given a new patient registration request
    When the system processes the registration
    Then the registration should be completed within <response_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | response_time |
      | 4             |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Consultation Requests Performance
    Given a patient consultation request
    When the system processes the consultation request
    Then the consultation request should be completed within <response_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | response_time |
      | 2             |

  Scenario Outline: Chemist Prescription Requests Performance
    Given a chemist prescription request
    When the system processes the prescription request
    Then the prescription request should be completed within <response_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | response_time |
      | 2             |

  Scenario Outline: Labs Lab Requests Performance
    Given a lab request
    When the system processes the lab request
    Then the lab request should be completed within <response_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | response_time |
      | 4             |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Prescription & Invoice Look-up Performance
    Given a patient prescription and invoice look-up request
    When the system processes the look-up request
    Then the look-up request should be completed within <response_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | response_time |
      | 4             |
```
